thaumichorizons.vat.structure: Build a 3×4×3 structure. Top and bottom: an alchemical construct surrounded by eight greatwood planks. Both middle layers: a water source surrounded by eight glass blocks. Right-click with a wand to assemble, spending 50 Aqua, Terra and Ordo vis. Attach essentia pipes to the four bottom edge centres. Sneak-right-click the lid to enter; right-click again to leave.
thaumichorizons.gold_egg_smelting: Smelt a golden egg in a furnace to obtain one gold nugget (1 experience).
thaumichorizons.tumor.description: A warped tumor isolates warp inside your current body, absorbing permanent warp first, then sticky and temporary warp. The server setting warpedTumorValue controls its capacity, defaulting to 50. Death or replacement of the body returns the stored warp in its original categories. This is not permanent purification.
thaumichorizons.plane.creation: Throw one Primordial Pearl into a formed rift held by six stabilizer beams. A named pearl names the plane. Generation runs in stages and retains the pearl until the central return portal is ready. A failed job can return its pearl when the source is used with a wand; removing the unfinished source also queues a refund. Extra pearls are not consumed. Touch the completed rift to enter. Use a blank keystone on the return rift inside the plane to bind it.
thaumichorizons.gateway.structure: Build a vertical 5 by 5 frame along X or Z: four advanced alchemical constructs at the corners, a keystone slot at the top centre, and eleven eldritch stone blocks along the remaining edges. Leave the 3 by 3 centre empty. Insert a bound keystone and use a wand with 250 of every primal vis (crafting discounts apply). Each plane supports four simultaneous gateways. Empty-hand use removes the keystone and closes both ends. Breaking the slot returns the original key. A damaged frame closes the link.
thaumichorizons.cloud.availability: Clouds and leviathan remains are available in Creative mode. Their natural generation methods were empty in the reference version; this port does not invent a survival recipe. Scan either block to discover its research after Pocket Planes. Cloud precipitation follows overworld rain, even in another dimension.
thaumichorizons.node_cheat.tip: Testing tool: transforms an aura node into a self-stabilized rift.
thaumichorizons.suicide_pill.tip: Testing tool: deals fatal damage to your current body, including in Creative mode. The item is reusable.
death.attack.thaumichorizons.suicide: %1$s ended their current body in a test
thaumichorizons.vat.preview: Drag to rotate. Scroll or click arrows for layers. Blue marks water sources.
thaumichorizons.jar.vat_recovery_hint: Use on an empty vat to restore its creature, inventory and paid infusion progress.
